status: actual previous-copy loss reproduced; required repair design, not implemented
defect: With valid current conversations, a damaged current water file and a readable valid previous water file, prepareLinkedChange retires .previous before the unrelated new change commits. The baseline discards that new transaction and still observes the old water copy gone.
requiredStorageContract: Before any generic retirement of .previous, establish whether current health files can be opened and retain every prior health file that may be needed to recover a failed current domain. Conversation readability alone is insufficient.

Retain exact original bytes and ownership/provenance; do not silently install the previous records into the live store or authorize old Health operations. A valid unrelated domain must remain usable when a safe recovery copy can be preserved.

Use a private recovery area inside the current data root so the existing explicit checked account-reset replacement can erase it coherently. Backups must continue to use explicit snapshot fields rather than automatically exporting private copies or journals.

Retain the affected domain files and required meal photos without recursively mirroring earlier recovery folders. Hard links may preserve immutable regular-file bytes on the same volume; no source mutation, symlink following or broad directory deletion.

Preserve prior private recovery copies that exist only in .previous. Reuse a duplicate only after actual byte/path comparison; an unreadable or ambiguous copy is not permission to delete it. Keep capacity and disk failure behavior explicit.
A failed archival/staging/installation step must leave the original current and prior data recoverable. A successful archive must exist durably before generic preparation can retire the old path.

Distinguish absent current domains from failed current reads. Do not revive data intentionally removed by reset. Explicit reset/restore/corrupt-journal/foreign-device semantics must retain their original durable Health contract.

An actual backup/local-copy recovery operation needs a preview and explicit replacement semantics for unavailable domains. A Retry button alone cannot repair permanently invalid bytes, and manually replacing files in a test is not a shipped recovery UI.
requiredProof: Real current/previous Foundation trees: healthy/absent/corrupt/unreadable/non-regular/symlink combinations; the exact baseline good prior water survives unrelated successful updates and failed preparation.
Meals with shared and missing/unreadable photos, raw partially damaged prior data, existing private copies and exact duplicate/different-copy cases; no recursive archive growth or source mutation.
Faults before archival publication, during linked staging and during installation, plus actual interruption/reopen boundaries. Independently inspect original and retained copy bytes before recovery.

Checked reset removes private recovery data in the same coherent erasure lifecycle; failed reset retains it. Explicit encrypted/readable/retained-copy recovery preserves damaged originals and queues no imported Health writes.

Native unavailable/retry/replacement presentation on main/compact normal/dark/largest with the same continuing critic; all remaining original durable groups, final regressions/Release/publication and device gates remain required.
scope: Required follow-up derived from an executed counterexample. The sourceR12 semantic-value repair does not modify ConversationFiles or BackupFileTransaction and does not close this defect.
